references.text: The Levites were set apart to have responsibility for the tabernacle of the testimony and all its equipment
The tribe of Levi was brought before Aaron the priest to serve him and care for the service at the tabernacle
The sons of Kohath were to carry the holy things, including the ark of the covenant
The Aaronic blessing that the priests were to use to bless the children of Israel in the name of the Lord
The Levites were set apart from the children of Israel and belonged to the Lord
The tribe of Levi was chosen to stand and serve in the name of the Lord at all times
The Levites were chosen to serve the Lord and bless in his name
The Levites carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord
The Levites who carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord were to place the book of the law beside the ark
The Levitical priests carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord when the people crossed the Jordan
The Levites were to carry the ark of God, for the Lord had chosen them for this task
Aaron and his sons were set apart to consecrate the Most Holy Place, offer incense, and bless in the name of the Lord forever
The Levitical priesthood is described as the foundation of the law given to the people
